lal-kitab/placements/evidence.yaml.edition: Lal Kitab has several historical editions. Bind the exact edition before activating a trait.
lal-kitab/placements/evidence.yaml.frame: Match a graha to its fixed house in the selected Lal Kitab method. Use source-specific traits only. Optional conduct prompts stay free.

nadi.permission: No Bhrigu Nandi Nadi progression or authenticity claim until sourced and explicitly released.

lal-kitab/placements/evidence.yaml.pakka_status: Candidate edition table; multiple rulers and editions differ. Admin study until locator checked.
lal-kitab/placements/evidence.yaml.soya: A planet without a qualifying aspect to another planet under the selected Lal Kitab edition is a sleeping-planet candidate. Missing edition-specific aspect table means unknown. Do not substitute Parashari drishti.

lal-kitab/varshphal/annual.yaml.edition_candidate: Pt. Roop Chand Joshi, Lal Kitab (1952); awaiting one authenticated edition and individual locators.
lal-kitab/varshphal/annual.yaml.frame: Use the age-year placement table from the chosen Lal Kitab edition. Preserve year index and natal house as inputs. Keep this annual chart distinct from the Tajika solar return.
lal-kitab/varshphal/annual.yaml.lookup: Use completed years + 1 and natal house 1..12. Require a transcribed row from a single edition and verified locator. No cyclic extrapolation.

rule.meaning: You can explore the planet through its recorded house.
rule.review_notes: Review exact locator, convention and native copy before release.
rule.rule: In the fixed-house Lal Kitab frame, slot one carries Aries and each following slot the next zodiac sign through Pisces in slot twelve. Preserve natal house occupancy; do not move planets to houses according to their natal sign.

sources.supports: Confirm the 1952 edition states the fixed-house, Aries = house 1 convention.
